name: SRK Staring at Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla in Darr Holi Scene
visual_description: Two-panel meme from Darr (1993). Top shows Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla hugging happily during Holi. Bottom shows Shah Rukh Khan in disguise with colored face playing a tambourine and glaring enviously.
usage_context: Used to portray jealousy, feeling left out, third-wheeling, or obsessively watching others enjoy what you desire.

example.bottom_text: Me planning how to ruin their day

text_areas.description: Label for the happy couple or favored group in the top panel
Label for the jealous/obsessed observer in the bottom panel
